; START Prusa 5_axis G-code
; We assume that machine is not stopped from planar construction


G90 ; use absolute coordinates

G0 Z80;

M104 S220 ; set extruder temp
M109 S220 ; wait for extruder temp
G21 ; set units to millimeters

G1 u0.1 v0.1; Give a little kick to A and B motor
G1 u0 v0 ;

G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; use relative distances for extrusion

M98 P"/macros/move_to_mid.g" ;move the nozzle to centre

G1 E0.1 ; initial extrusion
